_meta.source: Computed styles on https://onmarathon.com public pages, desktop 1440x900, html.light. Colour roles alias the CSS variables in raw/css-vars.json. Sizes are the computed px values (root font is 110%, so 1rem is 17.6px).

sans.source: computed font-family on body (html class light, body class font-sans); @font-face Inter variable 100-900 in the Next stylesheet, src redacted to url(…)

display.source: measured h1 on /for-agencies, computed font-size 81.4px / line-height 81.4px / weight 500

heading.source: measured h2 'Thanks for everything.' on /, computed 46.2px / 46.2px / 500

body.source: measured first main paragraph on /, computed 15px / 22.5px / 400

label.source: measured nav link and Get Started button, computed 15.4px / 22px / 500 (14px at 110% root)

caption.source: measured archive banner and Popular badge, computed 13.2px / 17.6px / 500 (12px at 110% root)

lg.source: computed .rounded-lg on a probe div, 17.6px (calc(var(--radius) * 1) at 110% root; --radius is 1rem)

full.source: measured Get Started, Pay Annually and Popular, border-radius 9999px

1.source: derived: 0.25rem at the measured 17.6px root (110%). Tailwind step, not a named Marathon token

2.source: measured segment padding-top 8.8px and badge padding-right 8.8px

3.source: measured banner padding-top 13.2px and primary button padding-right 13.2px

controlSm.source: measured header Get Started and Pay Annually height 39.5938px, and the phone menu button 39.5938px

controlMd.source: measured pricing and agencies Get Started height 48.3906px

icon.source: measured phone Open menu button width 39.6px; the painted glyph sits inside that circle. Icon file itself is the wordmark SVG

hairline.source: header bottom border observed as a 1px hairline on the screenshots; cards use box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rather than a border-width

fast.source: measured transition-duration 0.15s on nav links, buttons and the archive banner

ease.source: derived: computed transition-timing-function ease on those controls, expanded to the CSS keyword's control points

page.description: Page field. Computed on the public pages as white; the visible field reads slightly off-white from the body class, and the token is the declared variable.

textLink.source: text links use the foreground colour and add an underline on hover; there is no separate link colour

focus.source: measured focus-visible outline-color rgb(0, 95, 204) on links and buttons. Browser default, not a Marathon custom property

accentHover.description: Declared. The filled Get Started button hovers to #404040, not this lime.

accentPressed.source: pressed uses the same declared hover token; CDP active+hover on the lime banner did not change its fill

ink.description: Filled button face. Get Started, selected segment and Pro card button.

inkHover.source: measured primary button hover and pressed background rgb(64, 64, 64)

onInk.source: measured primary button color oklch(1 0 0), resolved #ffffff

destructive.description: Declared. No destructive control was painted on a public page.

page.description: Declared on .dark. Not painted on a public page.

bg.source: Get Started header button background oklch(0.15 0 0)

offset.source: measured outline-offset 1px on links and buttons; 0px on the pricing segment
